newsitem.title: CHINA: LAI SUN SAYS CROCODILE SHR SALE TALKS TERMINATED.
newsitem.headline: LAI SUN SAYS CROCODILE SHR SALE TALKS TERMINATED.

text.p: Lai Sun Garment (International) Ltd (LSGI) said on Friday talks to sell its interest in Crocodile Garments Ltd to a China-related third party have been terminated.
Lai Sun Garment was informed by the third party that it had decided not to proceed with such talks, the company said in a statement.

The company also denied local newspaper reports that Lai Sun Garment would possibily privatise its 54.93 percent of Crocodile. "LSGI wishes to confirm that LSGI has no intention to privatise Crocodile," it added.
Trading of shares in Lai Sun Garment and Crocodile resumed this morning after being suspended since Monday pending this announcement.
Crocodile shares plunged HK$0.21 to HK$0.90 in early Friday trading while Lai Sun shares were unchanged at HK$9.7.
